note:
Target-side rules this capture needs that the ported GLM-5.2 spec-5 set does not cover. Two reasons they are missing there: the spec-5 capture reduced through FlashInfer's `allreduce_fusion_kernel_twoshot_sync`, while this one takes the MNNVL path (`twoshotAllreduceKernel` + `rmsNormLamport`), and several DSA indexer kernels and GEMM tiles carry names that capture never saw.

One rule set, not a chain. Each predicate below is either a name that occurs in exactly one semantic position, or a name plus the *operation* of an immediate neighbour (never a tile name, which varies with shape). The neighbour-keyed rules need a second sweep to fire, which is why the driver runs to a label-state fixpoint.

Where one measured kernel occurs in layer families whose slots are named differently -- the three sparse families call it `moe.*` and the dense prefix calls it `ffn.*` -- the rule lists both suffixes under one operation. That is the same convention the ported file uses for its four-family GEMM rules: the operation is a semantic name and `slot_suffixes` does the resolution, so the pairing is correct in aggregate.

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::twoshotAllreduceKernel
rules.role: attention TP all-reduce fused with the following residual RMSNorm
rules.note: Keyed on the operation of the preceding position, not on its tile name: o_proj's `nvjet_*` variant changes with the batch, and this capture shows at least eight of them in front of this collective.

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::rmsNormLamport
rules.role: attention TP all-reduce fused with the following residual RMSNorm
rules.note: All 108 `rmsNormLamport` positions in the capture follow a `twoshotAllreduceKernel`, so the owner is whichever reduction that one is. The simulated slot is one fused `all_reduce_residual_rms_norm` leaf, so both measured kernels belong to it.

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::twoshotAllreduceKernel
rules.role: MoE TP all-reduce fused with the next block input residual RMSNorm
rules.note: Among this capture's `twoshotAllreduceKernel` positions the predecessor partitions them exactly three ways: `vectorized_elementwise_kernel` (54, the expert block), an o_proj `nvjet_*` tile (attention), and `vocab_parallel_embedding_kernel` (the embedding). So the generic predecessor name is a sound discriminator here even though it would not be in general.

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::rmsNormLamport
rules.role: MoE TP all-reduce fused with the next block input residual RMSNorm

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::twoshotAllreduceKernel
rules.note: This one is followed by a plain `rms_norm_kernel`, not `rmsNormLamport`: the embedding reduction is not fused with a residual add.

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::oneshotAllreduceFusionKernel
rules.role: attention TP all-reduce fused with the following residual RMSNorm
rules.note: The one-shot path fuses what the two-shot path splits across `twoshotAllreduceKernel` and `rmsNormLamport`, so there is a single position to label and no Lamport rule to pair with it. Which path runs is a batch-size decision inside FlashInfer; the simulated slot is the same fused leaf either way.

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::oneshotAllreduceFusionKernel
rules.role: MoE TP all-reduce fused with the next block input residual RMSNorm

rules.name: deep_gemm::sm100_mqa_logits
rules.role: DSA indexer MQA logits over the prefill query rows
rules.note: Only the two `full_index` families own an indexer; the `index_share` families reuse a previous layer's top-k and run none of these kernels.

rules.name: deep_gemm::sm100_paged_mqa_logits
rules.role: DSA indexer MQA logits over the paged decode rows

rules.name: vllm::cooperative::cooperative_topk_cs
rules.role: cooperative top-k over the decode indexer logits
rules.note: The `_cs2` and `_cs4` template variants are the same selection at different cluster sizes, so the shared prefix is the right predicate.

rules.name: _fused_norm_rope_kernel
rules.role: fused latent-KV norm and rope on the main attention path
rules.note: Sits between the fused QKV-A projection and the Q absorb in every layer of this capture. The simulated slot is `vllm_mla_rope`, whose measured rows are known to depend on batch size through a dynamo shape-cache limit -- that is a profiling caveat for the slot, not a reason to label this kernel elsewhere.

rules.name: fused_q_cutedsl
rules.role: DSA indexer query projection, CuTe-DSL fused
rules.note: Immediately precedes `cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache_kernel`, which the ported rules already own as `attention.indexer.prefill_cache_gather`, so it is on the indexer path and not the main one.

rules.name: vllm::act_and_mul_kernel
rules.role: SiLU and multiply between the shared expert's two projections
rules.note: The three dense layers run the same kernel as their FFN activation, which is why the dense suffix is listed too.

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::rmsNormLamport
rules.role: MoE TP all-reduce fused with the next block input residual RMSNorm
rules.note: Identified from the successor instead of the predecessor, for the reductions that open a folded segment body and so have no predecessor at all. The three reduction sites are distinguishable either way: only the expert block's is followed by the next layer's first projection. The attention one is followed by the router, and the embedding one by a plain `rms_norm_kernel` rather than the Lamport variant.

rules.name: trtllm_mnnvl_allreduce::twoshotAllreduceKernel
rules.role: MoE TP all-reduce fused with the next block input residual RMSNorm
rules.note: Fires after the rule above: the Lamport norm names the reduction it completes.
